title: Complete cheat-cosmology palette: actual mechanism, source chronology and optional continuity
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full palette review / historical proposal qualifiers / source and consumer gaps
reviews.disposition:
Complete owner-content reconciliation under AD5/AD8/AD22/AD32/AD38/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52 and existing continuation direction. All1469 pre-fold lines were actually read: original user wording/correction, eight backings and twelve placement fields, all25 placed cards, all simple-cheat rows, intake/trope method, ranking provenance, ten equalization modes, nine gift terms,25 opinion ranks, M01–M33/F1–F6/O1–O5, both-winner decisions, C10–C15/UC1–UC20/G1–G7, PS1–PS42/PS7a–f, anime/WN placements/CO1–CO5/N1–N5/A1/NA1–NA5, AL1–AL9, Haruhi/Steins;Gate/memory/history/HS1–HS9, BX1–BX5, CA13 and GP4–GP20 through B133/B285. Earlier selected-range notes are now superseded for content coverage by this full read, not retroactively broadened. Three actual row counts and rank arithmetic are saved in cosmology-table-check-b493.json. No linked report, private chapter, lore evidence or runtime body is read by implication.

Authority and retained alternatives. The user's original correction rejects the invented no-universal-rank ban, retains the fun ranking and asks for real verse equalization. Preserve both hierarchy-based and mechanism-based outcomes where the actual world/scenario supplies them; a genuine universal scale/exceptional cheat is possible, while an institutional rating can merely be a claim. Opinion scores are not source feats or a general resolver. Early tier words and C/PS/UC labels are vocabulary/palette IDs, not a newly accepted universal ladder or mandatory registry schema. The25-rank order is deliberately impression-based rather than sorted by total. M01–M33 cover28 distinct backing combinations plusfive cases; this is table coverage, not foreign matchup proof. The historical70/71 catalogue discrepancy has its later distinct catalogue review and is not a new original-source read here.

Function, carrier and mechanism. Soul/body/item/system/world-law/patron/knowledge/concept labels are starting questions, not automatic winners, transport guarantees or category permission lists. Separate carriage, activation, effect, contact, fuel/support, settlement and persistent result. A changed body may carry a world-law effect after its original trigger ends; an item can need external support; a distributed patron can reach farther than a local law; an intrinsically free or self-supplying power may need no external fuel. A hypothesis that a meta label works everywhere, that a body trait is automatically lost on body change, or that world-law support necessarily stays home needs its actual source/means. Unknown support is a research/implementation gap, not an invented fictional fee, weakness or prohibition. Keep each composite function's separate support rather than flatten a whole cheat into one backing.

Early simple-cheat and collision prose. The statements that scarcity must move, every strong cheat has a weakness rumor, proving a feat updates everyone, or high-layer power must add a different verb are old design suggestions. A genuinely100x/10000x/free duplication/god start can erase its former scarcity, work repeatedly and create no automatic rival, envy, tax or compensating bottleneck. Pushback requires an actual observer/agent/cause. Self-gifting, quotas, extraction attempts, single-use and caps are source/local dials, not exploit-hardening requirements. Exceptional unqualified premises are possible with actual world means; no universal anti-loop/diminishing-return patch follows. A mundane or quiet life remains valid after overwhelming growth. Trope collection/first-session/hour50 suggestions are taste/research ideas rather than three-source or50-hour release gates.

Time, knowledge and numeric scope. M and time-kind examples retain distinct mind-return, recreated world, checkpoint, rate, local reset, branch, patron/owner/cause-edit mechanisms. Nested domain size, earlier anchors and reset scars are possible resolver choices, not compulsory precedence or universally readable evidence. Removed causes can entirely avert an event; a named convergence/fixed beat requires the world's actual law, not franchise familiarity or a generator's preferred plot. Foreknowledge may remain accurate when its relevant causes remain; intervention is not an automatic accuracy tax. Reliable exact prophecy is possible through real means. Seed/save restoration and supernatural rewind are separate; native accidental duplicate grants differ from deliberately supported duplication. UC12's engine-float/overflow fiction needs safe numeric representation and a chosen mechanic, not actual accidental NaN/Infinity, data loss or an extra forced prestige. Higher/lower clock rates and catch-up must follow the selected clocks rather than a generic layer tick.

Observation and ratings. A real event, source statement, analyst inference, institution's scale, witness account, retained record and reader/player perspective remain distinct. Truth versus copies is a useful model when actual consumers need it, not a demand for one giant all-history log or a ban on genuine direct measurement/omniscience. Own native actionable quantities retain truthful views under AD8; a rating board with insufficient evidence can be wrong without making the application's real save/stock feedback deceptive. A public feat reaches observers through actual perception/transmission, not every NPC by default. A staged failure's true cause and the resulting mistaken account differ. PS7 survival/counter examples are nonexhaustive: a blade or name/role mechanism can reach several layers through its actual scope, and erasing recollection is not automatically erasing an independently supported concept. Institutional consequences require an actual consumer, not just a category name.

Names, gifts and crafting. Registered/given/true/honorific/remembered/magic/hidden names target different records, people and channels. Remembered names can cross with actual minds/records/links; arriving where nobody knew you is not literally the same mechanism as name erasure. Other remote name channels may also be attacked without touching the body. Naming need not dominate, and a public name or glyph is not an automatic binding. Gift/digested/matured/lease/loan/lien/leash/bound-item terms describe actual rights/support/removal; a label cannot guarantee permanence or revocation against every stronger means. In particular the LOTM digestion illustration is not fresh primary proof of irreversible patron independence. AL's recipe/material/fuel/operator model is a reusable analytical palette, not proof every craft requires those exact four fields. Knowledge needs a real carrier, and tools, facilities, actual material properties and operator execution can matter. Stored/alternative/free supplies can make manufacture portable; exchange versus multiplication need not always bill another party or attract attention. Novel/games/wiki/scan fields remain source-qualified rather than forced into universal chemistry.

Source chronology. Keep I/U, remembered wiki-only, scan summaries, shown/stated and reported full-WN reading boundaries explicit. Re:Zero arcs1–4 versus5–10, Toaru/Code Geass wiki/memory, blocked alchemy wiki/no-primary scan and Haruhi/Steins;Gate wiki labels retain their original evidence limits. Later Tensura WN rows and Slime addendum supersede early CO4's exact/absolute EP characterization with a rough in-world estimate. Reported304 chapters/70spot checks are that source task's claim; retaining this report does not certify it anew. Operation on Earth by a matured specific power does not automatically transfer to an early stage, a recipe factory or every counterpart. Corrected naming payers/bonds, independent makers, supported domains, copied memories versus surviving soul and protected observation keep their separate actual mechanisms.

Current continuity and retained growth ideas. BX1–BX5 correctly distinguish exchanged subject, authority/other claims, burden valuation, bundled consequences and committed roll/resource settlement. Profitable supported loops and genuinely broad exchange remain possible without mandatory revenge or arbitrary price; no universal exchange power was selected. CA13's quiet faculty default does not require a talking patron/shop or bar one through appropriate means. GP4–GP20 preserve useful long-life growth, optional alternate lives, companionship, skills, obligations, paused former-life default/portable clocks and coherent old-body return. A fixed reset-count reward cannot be called optional if it dominates every viable growth route; equally, a real world loop may center resets. Actual companions are not memories, counterparts or baggage inventory. Old-body conditioning/injury/reserves, continuing learned change, living transfers, held goods and another person's knowledge/choice need their proper owners. Completed-undelivered work differs from unfinished work. Preview is nonmutating; actual transition and failure/partial-arrival policy must come from the incumbent transaction, not an invented all-world atomicity guarantee. The named continuation symbols were originally inspected for limited seams and do not prove an implemented whole LOTM transition today.

Reopen and proof. Early G1/UC20/G7 one-realm/one-prestige-first suggestions are retired as project gates by later scope direction. Saved Q1/dependency/worker/model/allowance sentences are dated records, not current implementation status, active workers or renewed usage ceilings. Keep detailed hypotheses and GP/BX/PS/AL/UC ideas here, with runtime and source gaps in their existing selected owner. A later useful first shared seam follows AD51/AD52, desktop priority and current campaign order rather than requiring a new global cheat registry, all-world collision engine, full-community survey or repeated source wave. Human review is optional AD42. This full-content pass performs no new primary research, source-code edit/read, gameplay/build/browser/persistence/package/install test, acquisition, worker dispatch or publication.

reviews.reopen: Retain source-local ideas and exact source/consumer questions. Reopen a chosen real mechanism/continuity consumer under current direction, not early blanket gates.

Everything here is a proposal. Paths are relative to `docs/`.

**Current use, B493 (2026-11-05):** This file retains early proposals and later user-direction records. Read the full B493 reconciliation at the end before applying its old tables: backing labels do not guarantee portability, scarcity/weakness/pushback is not compulsory, names/knowledge need actual carriers, and the one-realm milestone is retired. Both rank-based and mechanism-based worlds remain possible (AD5/AD22/AD32/AD38). Detailed source and runtime gaps stay explicit; full document review is not new source/gameplay proof.
